name: Nitroxazepine
summary: Nitroxazepine (brand name Sintamil) is a tricyclic antidepressant (TCA) which was introduced by Ciba-Geigy (now Novartis) for the treatment of depression in India in 1982. It is also indicated for the treatment of nocturnal enuresis. Nitroxazepine acts as a serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor and has similar effects to imipramine, but with certain advantages, such as lower anticholinergic side effects.

summaryZh: 硝沙西平是一種含氮雜環化合物，化學式C18H19N3O4，為一種三環類抗抑鬱藥，由汽巴-嘉基（諾華的前身之一）開發，用以治療重性抑鬱障礙和夜遺尿。
summaryZhHans: 硝沙西平是一种含氮杂环化合物，化学式C18H19N3O4，为一种三环类抗抑郁药，由汽巴-嘉基（诺华的前身之一）开发，用以治疗重性抑郁障碍和夜遗尿。

sideEffects.en: Like other tricyclic antidepressants it can cause dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision, drowsiness and dizziness on standing. Tricyclics can disturb the heart's rhythm, and overdose on them is dangerous.
sideEffects.zh: 與其他三環抗憂鬱藥一樣，它可能造成口乾、便祕、視力模糊、嗜睡與站起時頭暈。三環類藥物可能擾亂心臟節律，過量時相當危險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 与其他三环抗忧郁药一样，它可能造成口干、便秘、视力模糊、嗜睡与站起时头晕。三环类药物可能扰乱心脏节律，过量时相当危险。

fact.en: Nitroxazepine was introduced in India in 1982 by Ciba-Geigy and, unusually for a tricyclic antidepressant, it has an oxygen atom built into its middle ring.
fact.zh: 硝沙西平於 1982 年由汽巴嘉基公司在印度推出，與一般三環抗憂鬱藥不同的是，它的中間環上嵌有一個氧原子。
